source: apple-importer; the web app must return the same result
apple_status_message: That looks like a sign-in or landing page — log in below (or wait for the conversation to appear), then press Capture again.
notes: The whole-page text of a signed-out landing page.

The guard function must give the same answer. In the Apple app nothing is saved and a one-line status asks the user to log in and capture again. The web app reports `sign_in_suspected` as a warning and must also offer 'import anyway' (allow_wall).
